construction.top_down: reviewed directory hierarchy, roles, classification axes, and textbook subdivisions
construction.bottom_up: existing concrete statements, assumptions, conclusions, and source locators
construction.hard_boundary: textbook catalogue witnesses validate traceability and topic placement, not mathematical correctness

roots.title: Convex Analysis
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Convex Analysis; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Convex Sets
children.top_down_role: Finite-dimensional convex-set geometry for optimization, organized around constructions, topology, asymptotic structure, extremal structure, metric and local geometry, separation, finite-witness principles, and feasibility certificates.

children.title: Convex Cones
children.top_down_role: Geometric, order-theoretic, dual, facial, representational, and structural theory of convex cones; conic optimization models and algorithms remain cross-linked.

children.title: Convex Functions
children.top_down_role: Structural theory of convex functions, their representations, preservation mechanisms, curvature regimes, growth geometry, and modeling interfaces.

children.title: Subdifferentials
children.top_down_role: Convex subdifferential geometry, representations, optimality principles, exact and approximate calculus, operator structure, computational interfaces, and failure regimes; general conjugacy, duality, proximal algorithms, variational convergence, and nonconvex generalized differentiation remain external.

children.title: Conjugacy
children.top_down_role: Convex conjugacy as a representation, calculus, convexification, duality, and reformulation framework; optimization algorithms, general conic programming, and mixed-integer solution methods remain external.

children.title: Polarity and Gauge Theory
children.top_down_role: Convex-geometric polarity, support and gauge representations, gauge duality, certificates, modeling templates, computational interfaces, and their applicability boundaries.

children.title: Polyhedral Convex Analysis
children.top_down_role: Finite-dimensional convex analysis specialized to finitely represented sets, cones, functions, and multifunctions, with geometric, variational, and computational viewpoints.

children.title: Convex Duality
children.top_down_role: Dual constructions, primal-dual value relations, multiplier certificates, perturbational interpretations, saddle formulations, qualification regimes, and duality failure phenomena for convex optimization.

children.title: Self-Concordance
children.top_down_role: Structural theory of self-concordant functions and barriers, their intrinsic geometry, Newton mechanisms, barrier parameters, and the principles supporting polynomial path following; full interior-point algorithms remain cross-linked.
